_: Example pictures for setups that are camera moves or rigs (cinema-examples.mjs): the frame the move produces, described without naming any equipment, because the picture model draws whatever gear the words mention. The prompt phrase the app adds is unchanged.
oner-continuous-take: A wide, deep view down the length of the whole café, from the entrance past the counter to her window table, everything in focus.
whip-pan-transition: A fast sideways motion blur streaks across the frame, the café smeared into horizontal lines, her red coat a red streak at the edge.
push-in-reveal: A close, intimate view moving toward her face, the background falling away into soft blur, her eyes catching the light.
pull-back-reveal: A wide view showing her small and alone at her table in the big empty café, the rainy street filling the huge window.
orbit-move: A three-quarter view from behind her shoulder as the view circles around her, the window light wrapping around her face.
crash-zoom: A sudden tight close-up on her startled eyes, slight zoom blur radiating from the centre of the frame.
dolly-counter-move: A dramatic warped perspective where she stays the same size but the café behind her stretches away, vertigo effect.
top-down-god-shot: Looking straight down from directly above: the round table, the coffee cup, her hands and the top of her head, a perfect overhead view.
low-mode-gimbal-chase: A very low view from just above the floor, chair legs and wet footprints in the foreground, her figure towering at the table beyond.
360-spin-reveal: A dizzying view with the café blurred in a circular sweep around her sharp figure at the centre.
vertical-rise-reveal: A high view rising above her table, looking down over the café and out through the top of the window at the rainy rooftops.
long-lens-compression-walk: A flattened, compressed view from far away through the window, her figure and the street traffic stacked close together, background huge and near.
first-person-pov-shot: Seen through the eyes of someone sitting opposite her: a hand holding a coffee cup in the bottom of the frame, her face across the table looking straight back.
over-the-shoulder-follow: Seen from just behind her shoulder and the back of her head, looking past her out of the rainy window at the street.
drone-flythrough-reveal: A sweeping high view gliding in from above the rainy street toward the lit café window where she sits.
static-hold-reveal: A perfectly still, symmetrical frame of the café window, her seated dead centre, nothing moving but the rain.
locked-off-tripod: A perfectly still, level, symmetrical frame of her at the window table, every line straight and calm.
handheld-urgency: A slightly tilted, unsteady close view of her, a little motion blur, urgent and raw like news footage.
steadicam-glide: A smooth, floating view gliding between the café tables toward her, everything steady and fluid.
crane-sweep: A high, sweeping view looking down across the whole café interior from near the ceiling, her small at her window table.
drone-descent: A high view from above the rainy street outside, looking down at the café's lit window and her figure inside.
snorricam-rig: Her face locked dead centre and perfectly sharp while the café around her tilts and swims in blur, disorienting.
probe-lens-pass-through: An extreme low close view from among the objects on the table: the rim of the coffee cup huge in the foreground, her face beyond.
high-speed-slow-mo: A frozen instant: rain droplets on the window sharp and suspended in mid-air, her hair caught mid-motion as she turns.
dolly-track-push: A smooth view gliding straight toward her along the line of tables, the tables on either side leading to her.
gimbal-walk-and-talk: A smooth view moving alongside her as she walks between the café tables, her coat in motion.
vehicle-mounted-rig: Seen from the rainy street through the café window, as if passing by in a car, raindrops and passing headlights streaking across the glass.
underwater-housing-rig: Seen through a glass of water on the table, her figure warped and refracted through the water and the curved glass.
jib-arm-rise: A view rising up from table height to above her head, looking down at her and the table from a high angle.
motion-control-repeat-pass: Several translucent copies of her overlapping in one frame, each in a slightly different pose, a precise ghostly repeated pass.
shoulder-mount-run-and-gun: A documentary-style close view of her at the table, slightly off-level, natural light, candid and immediate.
handheld-authenticity: A slightly unsteady, candid close view of her, natural light, a little off-level, like real documentary footage.
imperfect-focus-realism: Focus slightly off: the coffee cup in the foreground sharp, her face a touch soft, natural and imperfect.
